recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-11188; any future laboratory panel grouping or DiagnosticReport-vs-Observation modeling changes should proceed through newer dedicated grouping issues.
issue_request: FHIR-11188 was a Published OO change request resolved Persuasive with Modification. It asked to reduce confusion between Observation and DiagnosticReport; the final resolution was to add a sentence saying DiagnosticReport provides clinical/workflow context and references Observation to represent lab, imaging, and other clinical and diagnostic data as a complete report.
initial_application: Commit 9ae54e657c546e9a9e41f38013b06ff811f1b807 ([#11188] update Observation intro) added the requested sentence to source/observation/observation-introduction.xml. Commit fe6f87024bb28fc7e9742e5d8b8d336423d96c26 later changed "lab" to "laboratory" without changing the guidance.
additional_context: Observation and DiagnosticReport are active current-build resources in source/fhir.ini. Current Observation and DiagnosticReport narrative pages are consistent: Observation retains lab/imaging examples and states DiagnosticReport supplies context and atomic-result aggregation; DiagnosticReport says reports include context and reference Observation for atomic results. Later OO minutes quote or rely on the same sentence without a discovered reversal.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the authoritative current source already satisfies the Jira resolution. Adding the submitter's broader point-of-care-only restriction would exceed the final Jira disposition and conflict with later broader Observation scope guidance.

related_jiras.note: Earlier Observation guidance added laboratory/imaging examples and DiagnosticReport boundary text; it is already represented on the combined branch.
Later broadened Observation scope while preserving the DiagnosticReport relationship; it is already represented on the combined branch.
